item.title: Grand Bahama Housing, China Healthcare, NIB Seniors
item.ns0:title: Grand Bahama Housing, China Healthcare, NIB Seniors
item.description: Tonight on Our News Weekend, the government outlines plans to construct hundreds of new storm-resilient homes in Grand Bahama as part of a major redevelopment push for long-troubled communities like Garden Villas. Meanwhile, three decades of diplomatic partnership between The Bahamas and China bring new funding and medical training opportunities to strengthen local healthcare. Plus, the National Insurance Board marks 52 years of service by giving back to seniors, while local financial institutions team up to teach real-world money management in high school classrooms. Tune in for all these top stories, inspiring features on local creatives, sports highlights, and your complete weekend weather forecast! ----- Copyright Disclaimer under section 107 of the Copyright Act of 1976, allowance is made for "fair use" for purposes such as criticism, comment, news reporting, teaching, scholarship, education and research.
